metadata.summary: Remarks by Danny Danon, Permanent Representative of Israel to the United Nations, on the Task Force to Combat Anti-Semitism - Security Council Media Stakeout.

sentences.text: Good morning.
First, I would like to thank my colleagues for joining us today for this important meeting.
The words "Never again" were not meant to be a slogan.
They were meant to be a commitment.
Today, we are issuing a warning.
Antisemitism is up 137% since before October 7th in the seven countries with the biggest Jewish communities.

sentences.text: Elie Wiesel, of blessed memory, a survivor of Auschwitz and Buchenwald, warned us about the consequences of being a bystander.
He said, and I quote, "The opposite of love is not hate.
It is indifference."
So today, we have a choice.
We can watch history repeat itself, or we can stand together and change its course.
